name: Inshoku no Mahou Shoujo Tentacle!! The Bad End
original_name: 淫触の魔法少女テンタクル！　Ｔｈｅ　ＢＡＤＥＮＤ
source:
Epic lewd series Magical Girl Tentacle reaches its final chapter, and it's not a happy one!!
The two heroines "Tentacle" and "Nemeratia" from the 1st and 2nd ADV are seedbeds of pulsing eggspawn.
It's a violatory story of how thick squirming phalli of the majiverse consume the magical duo's sweet pink everything, hole by hole.
Will the Bad End ravishment bring downfall or ecstasy? Whatever happens, two magical girls will never see the human world again...

Story
Azusa (aka Magical Girl Tentacle) now knew her rival Nemeratia's true form was best friend Saki.
United in their mission to save the queen they at last arrived in the magical kingdom of Rohoforata, but Brekiozoa stood in their way.
In the ensuing battle the true mastermind revealed herself: it was queen Tentacle Uta, the one they were here to save!
Azusa and Saki were seized, helpless, for the unspeakable breeding. The BAD END. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE116153.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
史诗淫乱系列《魔法少女触手》终于迎来最终章了，这可不是什么开心的事！！
第1部和第2部ADV中的两位女主角“触手”和“Nemeratia”是脉动卵卵的苗床。
这是一个充满暴力的故事，讲述了Majiverse的粗大蠕动的阳具如何逐个洞地吞噬这对神奇二人组甜美的粉红色一切。
Bad End的蹂躏会带来垮台还是狂喜？不管发生什么，两个魔法少女将再也见不到人类世界了……

故事
梓（又名魔法少女触手）现在知道她的对手涅梅拉蒂亚的真实形态是最好的朋友咲希。
他们团结一致，肩负着拯救女王的使命，最终到达了魔法王国罗霍弗拉塔，但布雷基奥佐亚挡住了他们的去路。
在接下来的战斗中，真正的幕后黑手现身了：那是触手乌塔女王，他们是来拯救的！
梓和咲被抓住，无能为力，因为难以言表的滋生。糟糕的结局。
